scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n portal,computer,price,receipt,badge,server -c cyan,blue,red,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev --workspace @lenovo-store/web" "npm run dev --workspace @lenovo-store/computer-labels" "npm run dev --workspace @lenovo-store/price-labels" "npm run dev --workspace @lenovo-store/receipt-assistant" "npm run dev --workspace @lenovo-store/employee-badges" "npm run dev --workspace @lenovo-store/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lenovo-store/web && npm run build --workspace @lenovo-store/computer-labels && npm run build --workspace @lenovo-store/price-labels && npm run build --workspace @lenovo-store/receipt-assistant && npm run build --workspace @lenovo-store/employee-badges
scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && node --check scripts/migrate-legacy-data.js && node --check scripts/backup-data.js
